rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken modifier for something that occurs every month.

example.english: Our monthly meeting is always held on Monday.
example.traditional: 我哋每個月嘅會議都喺星期一開。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 jyut6 ge3 wui6 ji5 dou1 hai2 sing1 kei4 jat1 hoi1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to say that something happens every month.

example.english: I go for dim sum monthly.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 heoi3 jam2 caa4
